About Arsen Kogyo

Arsen Kogyo (富士達商貿) is a trading and manufacturing partner based in Taiwan, specialising in grinding consumables and pneumatic tools.

We serve two kinds of customers:

  • Workshops and professionals buying ready-made tools through our online store.
  • Brands, distributors and manufacturers who need OEM/ODM products made to specification.

Have a finishing problem?

Send us your material, a photo or a sample. We will recommend a product or develop one for you.
